    Sunday, 13 December 2026 · 4:15 AM IST

    For the couple: set up the stream with OBS Studio
    1. Create a live event in YouTube Studio (or Facebook Live) and set it to Unlisted. Copy the stream key and the watch link.
    2. In OBS Studio open Settings, then Stream. Choose YouTube or Facebook, paste the key, and add your camera and microphone as sources.
    3. Put the watch link into CONFIG.stream.url in this page and republish. The button above switches to "Watch live" by itself.
    4. Start streaming in OBS fifteen minutes before the ceremony and test the sound with a friend on another phone.

    Viewers open the stream in a new tab because this page cannot play YouTube or Facebook video inside itself.
